messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square maximizing the minimum area over all 286 triangles consists of the 12 vertices of a 3×4 grid (i.e., {0,1/3,2/3} × {0,1/2,1}) plus the center point (1/3,1/2), and the maximum achievable minimum triangle area is exactly 1/36. This is proven optimal because any triangle of area less than 1/36 in the unit square cannot have all three vertices drawn from a set of 13 points whose mutual spacing constraints force at least one such small-area triple."}
